description: This file contains the implementation of the Opencart Admin Model for handling voucher themes, including methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving voucher theme data and descriptions.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: Class for managing voucher theme data within the OpenCart admin model, including CRUD operations and localized descriptions.

methods.name: addVoucherTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new voucher theme record into the database and adds localized descriptions.

methods.name: editVoucherTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing voucher theme record, its descriptions, and clears relevant cache.

methods.name: deleteVoucherTheme
methods.description: Deletes a voucher theme and associated descriptions, and clears the cache.

methods.name: getVoucherTheme
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific voucher theme, including localized description.

methods.name: getVoucherThemes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of voucher themes with optional ordering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalVoucherThemes
methods.description: Returns the total count of voucher themes in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a localized description for a specific voucher theme and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a particular voucher theme.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all voucher theme descriptions for a particular language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given voucher theme across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all voucher theme descriptions for a specific language.
